title: Uniform bound, support and pointwise limit of the monotonicity kernels (parent Step 6)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, σ, ρ ∈ ℝ with 0 < σ ≤ ρ, and for m ∈ ℕ let φ_m: ℝ → ℝ be nonincreasing and ε_m ∈ ℝ with ε_m → 0, 0 < ε_m ≤ 1, φ_m(t) = 1 for t ≤ 1 and φ_m(t) = 0 for t ≥ 1 + ε_m. Put k_m(s) := ∫_{(σ,ρ]} −(s/τ²)·φ_m'(s/τ)/τⁿ dτ, where φ_m' := deriv φ_m, and D_m(s) := φ_m(s/ρ) − φ_m(s/σ). Assume that for all m and all s > 0, D_m(s)/sⁿ ≤ k_m(s) ≤ (1 + ε_m)ⁿ·(D_m(s)/sⁿ). Then: (1) every k_m is Borel measurable; (2) |k_m(s)| ≤ 2ⁿ/σⁿ for all m and all s ≥ 0; (3) k_m(s) = 0 for all m and all s > (1 + ε_m)ρ; (4) for every s ≥ 0, k_m(s) → 1_{(σ,ρ]}(s)·(sⁿ)^{-1} as m → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (σ ρ : ℝ) (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ m, 0 < ε m ∧ ε m ≤ 1) → (∀ m, Antitone (φ m)) → (∀ m t, t ≤ 1 → φ m t = 1) → (∀ m t, 1 + ε m ≤ t → φ m t = 0) → (∀ m s, 0 < s → (φ m (s / ρ) - φ m (s / σ)) / s ^ n ≤ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n ∧ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n ≤ (1 + ε m) ^ n * ((φ m (s / ρ) - φ m (s / σ)) / s ^ n)) → (∀ m, Measurable (fun s ↦ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n)) ∧ (∀ m s, 0 ≤ s → |∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n| ≤ 2 ^ n / σ ^ n) ∧ (∀ m s, (1 + ε m) * ρ < s → ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n = 0) ∧ (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → Tendsto (fun m ↦ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n) atTop (𝓝 ((Ioc σ ρ).indicator (fun s ↦ (s ^ n)⁻¹) s)))
